title: Zesty Crispy British Sausages Full English Breakfast
description: A hearty British breakfast featuring crispy sausages, earthy mushrooms, and fresh parsley, all steamed to perfection in a bamboo steamer. This dish is anti-inflammatory friendly and perfect for a midnight craving.

ingredients.name: British sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably made with pork and sage

instructions: Fill a large pot with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and place a bamboo steamer over the pot.
Add the British sausages to the steamer and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the sausages are cooking, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and add the mushrooms, cooking until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the chopped parsley to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the eggs to the pan and scramble them until they are cooked through.
Add the halved tomatoes to the steamer and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked sausage on each plate, followed by a spoonful of scrambled eggs, a spoonful of mushrooms and parsley, a tomato half, and a spoonful of baked beans.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
